== Biography ==
{{Scotland Sticker}}
Margaret was baptised on 21 August 1743 in Kilbirnie, Ayrshire, Scotland.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Margarat Glasgow 21 Aug 1743, daughter of Robert Glasgow and Margarat Allan; citing Ref No: 10 / 105, parish 596.</ref> She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1075|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Allan-4046|Margaret Allan]]. On 20 March 1764 in Kilbirnie, Margaret married [[Smith-398468|Andrew Smith]].<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Banns and Marriages," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), marriage of Andrew Smith and Margarat Glasgow, 20 Mar 1764; citing Ref No: 10 / 160, parish 596.</ref><ref>Dalry Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Banns and Marriages," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), marriage of Andrew Smith and Margaret Glasgow, 20 Mar 1764; citing Ref No: 20 / 183, parish 587.</ref> They had at least eight children:
#[[Smith-398469|Robert Smith]], born 16 November 1766.<ref>Dalry Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Robert Smith 23 Nov 1766, son of Andrew Smith; citing Ref No: 20 / 14, parish 587.</ref>
#[[Smith-398471|James Smith]], born 17 July 1768.<ref>Dalry Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), James Smith 23 Jul 1768, son of Andrew Smith; citing Ref No: 20 / 15, parish 587.</ref>
#[[Smith-398472|Andrew Smith]], born 14 January 1770.<ref>Dalry Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Andrew Smith 14 Jan 1770, son of Andrew Smith; citing Ref No: 20 / 17, parish 587.</ref>
#[[Smith-398473|Charles Smith]], born 20 February 1772,<ref>Dalry Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), Charles Smith 5 Mar 1772, son of Andrew Smith; citing Ref No: 20 / 19, parish 587.</ref> died in childhood.
#[[Smith-398474|William Smith]], born 17 September 1773.<ref>Dalry Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), William Smith 19 Sep 1773, son of Andrew Smith; citing Ref No: 20 / 23, parish 587.</ref>
#[[Smith-398475|Charles Smith]], born 14 March 1775.<ref>Dalry Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), Charles Smith 19 Mar 1775, son of Andrew Smith; citing Ref No: 20 / 26, parish 587.</ref>
#[[Smith-398476|Margaret Smith]], born 4 October 1776.<ref>Dalry Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), Margarat Smith 6 Oct 1776, daughter of Andrew Smith; citing Ref No: 20 / 29, parish 587.</ref>
#[[Smith-398477|Andrew Smith]], born 1 November 1783.<ref>Dalry Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2026), Andrew Smith 2 Nov 1783, son of Andrew Smith; citing Ref No: 20 / 45, parish 587.</ref>
